snippet.title: Best Gadget for new parents | How to use Baby Monitor | BOIFUN REVIEW
snippet.description:
Thinking of buying a baby monitor? In this video, I explain how a baby monitor actually works, what features you should look for before buying one, and whether a video baby monitor is really useful for new parents.

For this video, I’m using the **BOIFUN VB603 Baby Monitor** and sharing my experience with it. Although I’m reviewing this particular model, the video will also help you understand how most non-WiFi baby monitors work, so you know what to expect before buying one.

👶 Baby Monitor Featured:
BOIFUN VB603 Video Baby Monitor

Some of the key features of the BOIFUN VB603 include:

• 3.2-inch colour display  
• No WiFi required  
• Up to 260m transmission range in an open area  
• Infrared night vision  
• Two-way audio / talk-back  
• VOX mode that activates when sound is detected  
• Room temperature monitoring  
• Built-in lullabies  
• Feeding reminder  
• 2.4GHz wireless connection  
• Rechargeable parent monitor

I also explain how the advertised range works in real life, including why walls, different rooms and floors can reduce the range compared with the advertised open-field distance.

If you're a new parent, expecting a baby, or simply looking for a baby monitor with camera and audio, this video should give you a good idea of how these devices work before you spend your money.
